limitations: Source-bound reports are not independent kernel tracing or provider attestation.
Active API denials are defense in depth, not a hostile-code sandbox.
Only exact74 named paths are observed; unexpected JDK membership is not enumerated.
Stable pre/post checks do not exclude concurrent mutate-and-restore.
Filesystem calls or provider kill may prevent a final report; partial files are not accepted data.
Data differences never authorize runtime or change the frozen expected pins.
Separate exact local Git/gh phase review and fresh custody remain required; this selection is not blanket command authority.
